close.saveBody: If you don't save, your changes will be lost.

open.emptyRecent: No recent documents yet. Create or open a Markdown file to start writing.
open.emptyFolders: No recent folders yet. Use “Open Folder” to pick a workspace.
open.clearCurrentBody: This clears every entry in this list (pinned ones included). Files on disk are not touched. Continue?
open.hint: Ctrl+O to open a file · Ctrl+Shift+P to search documents
open.alreadyOpenTitle: This file is already open in another window
open.alreadyOpenBody: Switched back to the window showing {name}: editing the same file in two windows means the two copies overwrite each other.

outline.toRight: Put the outline to the right of the editor (3 columns)
outline.toLeft: Put the outline back in the left sidebar

sidebar.emptyOutline: No headings yet. Use # to create an outline.
sidebar.emptyFolderHint: Right-click to create a Markdown file
sidebar.listEmpty: No Markdown files in this workspace yet
sidebar.listEmptyHint: Create or import articles in the file tree to see them here

menu.updateUnavailable: No update channel is configured in this build (development), so updates cannot be checked

editor.placeholder: Start writing here… (type # for a heading)
editor.restoreDraft: Unsaved draft detected (newer than the file on disk)
editor.restoreDraftUntitled: Unsaved content from your last session detected
editor.draftHint: Choose Restore or Discard before you can keep editing this document.
editor.heading: Heading
editor.tableAlignHint: Set the alignment of the column the cursor is in
editor.tableAlignNeedTable: Put the cursor inside a table first
editor.saveConflictTitle: {name} was changed on disk by another program
editor.saveConflictBody: What you are editing no longer matches the file on disk (git branch switch, sync folder, or another editor), so nothing was written. Saving anyway would overwrite the on-disk version; you can cancel and then pick Save as or Reopen from the notification centre.
editor.dirtyConfirmBody: This document has unsaved changes. Leave anyway?
editor.externalChangeBody: Changes to this content were detected. Reload it?
editor.saveAfterReopenTitle: This content was reinterpreted with another encoding
editor.saveAfterReopenBody: The buffer currently holds the disk bytes reinterpreted as “{enc}” (likely mojibake) — this is **not** an encoding conversion. Writing it back now overwrites the original content. Save anyway?
editor.deleteConfirmBody: Delete "{name}"? It will be moved to the system recycle bin (you can restore it from there).
editor.deleteUnsavedWarn: This document has unsaved changes: a local draft is kept before deletion, so you can still recover it on the next launch.
editor.mermaidPreviewError: Syntax error: the last successfully rendered diagram is kept below
editor.mermaidEmpty: Empty Mermaid block (click to edit source)
editor.splitDividerTitle: Drag to resize the panes; double-click to reset
editor.syncScrollOn: Sync scrolling is on (click to turn off)
editor.pasteDegradedTitle: Content too large — pasted in reduced form
editor.pasteDegradedBody: Omitted {n} inline image(s) ({mb} MB total). The rest (text/tables/math) was pasted normally. Insert those images as local files instead.
editor.pasteFallbackTitle: Structure too complex — pasted as plain text
editor.pasteFallbackBody: The content had about {elements} elements, nested up to {depth} levels deep, beyond what can be rendered safely{truncated}. Only plain text was kept to avoid freezing.
editor.pasteRejectedBody: Inline images total about {mb} MB, above the limit (single {single} MB / total {total} MB). The document was not modified.
editor.pasteRollbackTitle: Paste took too long — rolled back
editor.pasteRollbackBody: This paste took {ms} ms, above the {budget} ms budget. The document was restored to its pre-paste state.
editor.heavyWorkDeferredBody: This serialization/statistics run took {ms} ms, above the per-run budget. Spell check and background statistics were postponed so the UI stays responsive; content and saving are unaffected.
editor.pastePlainEmpty: There is no plain text on the clipboard
editor.freezeDetectedTitle: A long main-thread block was recorded
editor.freezeDetectedBody: The main thread was occupied by synchronous work for about {ms} ms. The UI has recovered; the diagnostic record is in window.__LWORK — include it when reporting the issue.
editor.largeDocPromptTitle: This document is large and may be slow
editor.largeDocPromptBody: This document is about {mb} MB with roughly {nodes} nodes. Live rendering parses the whole document and builds the rich-text DOM first, which can be noticeably slow. Open it in source mode (character-exact editing, switch back anytime) or open it anyway.
editor.safeModeTitle: This document crashed or froze twice in a row — opened in source mode
editor.safeModeBody: To avoid another freeze, this document is opened in source mode this time (plain text editing, no rich-text DOM). If it is healthy again, you can switch back to live rendering.
editor.imageLoadFailed: Image failed to load (check whether the file was moved or deleted, or reopen the document)

settings.title: Settings
settings.persistHint: Changes are saved to the local database instantly
settings.themeDesc: Theme changes apply instantly with a smooth transition
settings.sidebarDesc: Show the left sidebar by default
settings.restoreSession: Restore the last session on startup
settings.restoreSessionDesc: Reopen the documents from last time and put the caret and scroll position back (each window restores its own)
settings.outlineRightDesc: Three-column layout: the left sidebar keeps only the file tree and the outline is pinned to the right of the editor (collapsible), so both are visible at once. Off = the original sidebar-tab structure
settings.autoCheckUpdateDesc: Show a notification when a new version is available. Only works in packaged builds with a configured update channel; off by default.
settings.linksCreateModeDesc: What to do when the linked file or folder does not exist
settings.linksHistoryDesc: Stored in the local SQLite database; delete entries individually or clear all
settings.linksForgetBody: Deletes the open record for “{target}” (its count and timestamps cannot be restored). Continue?
settings.linksClearBody: Deletes every link-open record permanently. Continue?
settings.encodingHint: Encoding used when opening files. "Auto Detect" checks the BOM first, then this file's remembered encoding, then whether the bytes are valid UTF-8, and finally guesses from the system language (Chinese → GB18030, Japanese → Shift_JIS, Korean → EUC-KR, Russian → Windows-1251, otherwise → Windows-1252). To change a single document temporarily, use File → Reopen with Encoding.
settings.defaultEolHint: Used for new and untitled documents; existing files keep their own
settings.historyHint: Keeps the content about to be overwritten before each save so a bad save can be rolled back. Turning it off stops new snapshots; existing ones stay viewable.
settings.remoteImagesHint: Load automatically when a document opens (the common default); choose 'Load on click' to stay offline until you click
settings.modeWysiwygDesc: WYSIWYG — click any block to edit
settings.modeSplitDesc: Rendered and source side by side; drag the divider to resize
settings.nativeMenuBarDesc: Hides the menu bar; keyboard shortcuts still work
settings.outlineRightShort: Three-pane layout: file tree and outline together (collapsible)
settings.rightDockShort: A persistent 40px vertical dock (Outline button) on the right; turn it off to hide both the dock and the panel so the editor uses the full width
settings.rightDockUnavailable: The outline is currently in the left sidebar, so the right dock has no button to show and stays hidden. Turn on "Outline on the right" above to make this switch effective.
settings.rightDockDesc: The right dock stays at the far right of the window with a single Outline button. Click it to open the outline panel to the left of the dock, click again to collapse it. Turning this off hides the whole dock and panel; turning it back on restores the expanded state.
settings.autoSaveManualHint: In manual mode, save with Ctrl+S or the status bar
settings.historyEnabledDesc: Keeps one rollback snapshot before each save
settings.autoCheckUpdateHint: Only applies to packaged builds that have an update channel
settings.syncScrollDesc: Syncs both panes by scroll progress
settings.codeLineNumbersDesc: Shows line numbers beside code blocks
settings.hideInlineMarkersDesc: Never shows marker characters such as **bold**, *italic*, ~~strike~~ or `code`; saving and export are unaffected
settings.wordGoalDesc: Shows “current / goal” in the status bar; 0 = no goal
settings.wordGoalHint: The goal applies to every document (a global setting). Once reached, the status bar cell turns accent-coloured with a check mark — no pop-ups.
settings.spellcheckEnabledDesc: Spell checking for the body: Chinese uses heuristic rules, other languages use the system dictionaries; code blocks, mermaid and math source are skipped
settings.spellcheckLanguagesDesc: Select one or more; the first item, Chinese (Simplified), uses Lumin's heuristic rules and the rest come from the system dictionaries. Right-click a hit to apply a fix
settings.spellcheckNoLanguages: No Chromium spelling dictionaries are available on this system; Chinese (Simplified) heuristic checking still works
settings.spellcheckKeepOne: Keep at least one language; turn the main switch off if you do not want spell check
settings.spellcheckZhNote: Chinese checking uses Lumin's heuristic rules (repeated characters/words, punctuation, common confusions) — it is not a dictionary-based checker.
settings.unresponsivePromptEnabledDesc: Show the Wait / Reload and recover dialog only when the window is visible and the page is actually frozen; minimized, hidden, or sleeping windows never prompt. Turning this off stops the check (crash recovery still runs).
settings.exportPdfDesc: Vector layout, good for printing and sharing
settings.exportHtmlDesc: Web page that keeps styling and links
settings.exportWordDesc: Saves an .html file that Word opens directly
settings.exportUsageHint: Use Export from the editor toolbar.
settings.resetConfirm: All settings return to their defaults (language and theme included). Continue?
settings.startupDiagnosticsFailed: Could not export startup diagnostics (log not writable or invalid path)
settings.diagnosticsCopied: Diagnostics copied to the clipboard (no document content)
settings.exportNote: Export notes: HTML and Word are both HTML documents — Word opens them for editing, but they are not real .docx (OOXML). EPUB splits by top-level headings and embeds local images; PDF gets page numbers and a header.
settings.dbMaintenanceHint: Check integrity, rebuild the search index, compact the database. All three run only on click (compaction rebuilds the whole file and can take a few seconds on large databases).
settings.backupHint: Copies the database (local history, tags and settings all live in it) to a directory you choose, keeping the latest 7. You can also pack the whole workspace into one zip.
settings.backupAutoDesc: Once a day, keeping the latest 7. Local history has no other copy, so leaving this on is recommended.
settings.backupDefaultDir: Default folder (same drive as app data)
settings.backupDirSameDisk: Backups sit on the same drive as the original data: pick another drive so a disk failure or ransomware cannot take both.
settings.backupSnapshotDesc: Packs the documents and images of the current workspace into one zip; hidden folders (.git, ...), write temp files and oversized files are skipped.
settings.backupSnapshotEmpty: nothing to archive in this workspace
settings.exportSettingsHint: Save the current settings and custom shortcuts as a JSON file; recently opened files and folders are never written
settings.importSettingsConfirm: Importing replaces the current settings (custom shortcuts included) with the {n} entries in the file; the local recent-file history is untouched. Continue?
settings.importErrNotJson: The file is not valid JSON
settings.importErrBadEnvelope: The file is not a settings export (app / version / payload missing)
settings.importErrWrongApp: This file was not exported by Lumin
settings.importErrUnknownVersion: The file comes from a newer version and cannot be imported
settings.importErrUnsafePath: A local path field in the file is invalid (absolute path, ".." or empty)
settings.importErrTooLarge: The file is too large; import refused

toolbar.visibleDesc: The shortcut toolbar above the editor. When hidden, bring it back from View → Show Shortcut Toolbar or the switch in Settings.
toolbar.allHidden: Every item is hidden — add some back from the list below
toolbar.hint: Order can be changed inside a group (separators are drawn between groups). Changes apply and save immediately.

links.confirmFile: “{path}” does not exist. Create this file (missing parent folders are created too)?
links.confirmDir: “{path}” does not exist. Create this folder (missing parent folders are created too)?
links.afterWindow: It will be opened in a new window afterwards.
links.afterDefault: It will be opened with the system default app afterwards.
links.errScheme: Unsupported link protocol (only http/https/mailto and local paths are allowed)
links.errNoBase: The document is unsaved and no workspace is open, so the relative link cannot be resolved
links.errInvalid: The link is empty or malformed
links.errUnsafeTarget: For safety, Lumin will not open executable files or scripts (.exe/.bat/.ps1/.lnk …) straight from a document. Check the source in File Explorer and open it there instead.
links.errCannotCreate: This file type cannot be created (only text files and folders)
links.errNeverCreate: Skipped as configured: target does not exist
links.errOpen: Could not open with the default app

session.restoreFailed: Could not restore the previous document (the file may have been moved or deleted)

support.title: A small note from the author
support.line1: Lumin is a small, one-person project — no ads, no subscription.
support.line2: If it happens to help you, I'd be glad. If you feel like it, a Star on the project or a coffee for the author is always appreciated — but never expected.

about.desc: Lumin is a cross-platform desktop Markdown editor built on Electron, with WYSIWYG at its core — a professional-grade, immersive writing experience for long-form work.
about.licensesHint: Click to expand the third-party notices (generated by npm run notices)
about.logsHint: If startup is slow or the app crashes, export this log and send it to us (redacted; no document content)
about.mirrorsHint: GitHub is the primary repository; Gitee and GitCode are mirrors. Please report issues on GitHub first.

toast.printNoReason: The print system did not report a reason
toast.renameUndoFailed: Could not undo the rename (the old name may be taken)
toast.renameExists: A file with that name already exists here — rename cancelled (nothing was overwritten)
toast.moveExists: The target folder already has an item with that name — nothing was moved (existing files are never overwritten)
toast.moveIntoSelf: A folder cannot be moved into itself or into one of its own subfolders
toast.moveOutside: The target folder is not inside the current workspace — nothing was moved
toast.deletePermanent: This location has no recycle bin — the file was deleted permanently
toast.saveParentMissing: Save failed: the folder that held this file no longer exists (deleted or renamed elsewhere). Use Save as to store it somewhere else.
toast.encodingReopenAutoSaveSkipped: Auto-save skipped to avoid writing mojibake back to disk (content is currently reinterpreted as “{enc}”). Save manually once you are sure about the encoding.
toast.encodingNeedsRestart: Encoding needs an app restart to take effect (main process is not hot-reloaded)
toast.encodingLossySave: The current encoding ({enc}) cannot represent some characters in this document: this save replaced them with ?. Switch to UTF-8 to keep them intact.
toast.historyRestored: Loaded the version from {time} — save to apply
toast.historyNeedsFile: Local history is only available for documents saved on disk
toast.heavyDocSourceMode: This document has {fences} code blocks; live rendering would be very slow, so it was opened in source mode (you can switch to the rendered view at any time)
toast.heavyDocSourceModeChars: This document has {chars} characters; live rendering would take 6+ seconds and use over 1GB of memory, so it was opened in source mode (you can switch to the rendered view at any time)
toast.plainTextSourceMode: "{name}" is a plain-text file, so it opened in source mode (live rendering would reinterpret it as Markdown and could rewrite the content on save; you can switch at any time)
toast.encodingNotSaved: This document is not saved to disk yet, so it cannot be re-read with another encoding
toast.imageNeedsWorkspace: Save this document first (or open a workspace) so the image can be stored in assets/
toast.tagsNeedSave: Save the document first so tags can be stored

editorMenu.linkAnchorHint: Left empty, the URL is used as the anchor text
editorMenu.linkUrlInvalid: This URL is not supported (only http / https / mailto and similar protocols)
editorMenu.linkFromSelection: Link text comes from the selection: "{text}"
editorMenu.pasteFailed: Cannot read the clipboard, use Ctrl+V instead
editorMenu.spellIgnoreHint: Hides this word for the rest of this run; the underline is still drawn by the system checker — use “Add to dictionary” to remove it for good
editorMenu.zhSpellIgnoreHint: Hides this occurrence for the rest of this run (remembered by its context fingerprint)

tableBar.label: Table quick actions
tableBar.widthNote: Display only: Markdown tables cannot store column widths

notifications.saveFailedBody: Reason: {reason}. Your text is still safe in a local draft; the app keeps retrying with exponential backoff (up to once every 60s).
notifications.saveConflictBody: This save was stopped to avoid overwriting what another program wrote. You can save a copy instead, or reopen the on-disk version (discarding your changes).

statusbar.encodingReplaced: Some bytes in this file could not be decoded with the current encoding (shown as \uFFFD). Saving will rewrite those bytes — check that the encoding is correct.
statusbar.eolTooltip: Line endings: {eol} — click to switch LF / CRLF (saves immediately)
statusbar.tagsTooltip: Tags (comma separated; used for grouping and search)
statusbar.wordGoalTooltip: Word goal: {current} / {goal} ({percent}%) — click to change in Settings
statusbar.wordGoalReachedTooltip: Word goal reached: {current} / {goal} — click to change in Settings

keymap.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keymap.desc: Click the keyboard icon, then press the new combination (Esc cancels, Backspace clears the binding). Defaults match the system; changes apply instantly and are stored in SQLite.
keymap.conflictWith: Conflicts with “{names}” — the later registration wins
keymap.hint: App-level shortcuts are managed here; editor-internal keys (Ctrl+B/I/U, Ctrl+Z/Y, …) are handled by the editor engine.
keymap.errModifierRequired: Must include Ctrl/Cmd or Alt (Shift alone does not count)
keymap.errReserved: Reserved by the system and cannot be bound
keymap.invalidHint: This binding is invalid: {reason}. Please restore the default.
keymap.keyFilterConflict: Multiple commands use {keys}; see the Conflict badges below

commandPalette.title: Command Palette
commandPalette.placeholder: Type a command name (Ctrl+Shift+P to open)
commandPalette.hint: Type to filter, use Up/Down to move, Enter to run, Esc to close

update.availableBody: Lumin {version} has been released — download it from the release page.
update.downloadedBody: Version {version} has been downloaded and will be installed after you quit Lumin.
update.errorBody: Cannot reach the update server right now: {message}

history.title: Local History
history.empty: No history yet. A snapshot of the previous content is kept before every save.
history.clearBody: All snapshots of this document will be deleted permanently. Continue?
history.hint: Clicking an entry loads it into the editor (nothing is written to disk): review, then Ctrl+S.

globalSearch.hintEmpty: Workspace documents are indexed in the background; you can also open or save one to search
globalSearch.replaceNoWorkspace: Replace in files needs an open workspace
globalSearch.replaceConfirmBody: Replace “{query}” with “{replacement}”: {files} file(s), {n} occurrence(s) in total. This cannot be undone.
globalSearch.replaceConfirmSkip: Skipped documents with unsaved changes (not written): {list}
globalSearch.replaceConfirmIndexing: Note: the full-text index is still being built, so documents that are not indexed yet will not be replaced.
globalSearch.replaceConfirmErrors: {n} file(s) cannot be replaced this time and will be skipped: {list}

taskbar.openInNewWindow: Open in a new Lumin window

export.pdfEmpty: PDF rendering returned an empty result

diagnostics.title: Lumin diagnostics
diagnostics.note: This file contains no document content and no list of recently opened files — safe to paste anywhere.

freeze.unresponsiveTitle: The page is slow or unresponsive
freeze.unresponsiveMessage: The Lumin page has not responded for {seconds} seconds.
freeze.unresponsiveDetail: You can keep waiting (it usually recovers when the synchronous work ends), or reload and recover. A last draft save is attempted before reloading; unsaved content relies on the automatic draft.
freeze.crashThrottledRecent: To avoid a crash loop, automatic reload is paused for {seconds} seconds. You can reload manually; unsaved text is recovered from the draft.
freeze.crashThrottledWindow: The page was auto-reloaded several times within 5 minutes, so automatic reload has stopped to avoid a crash loop. You can reload manually; unsaved text is recovered from the draft.
